changeSet.author: folio-droplock
changeSet.comment: nexus.drop_tenant_partitions looks the tenant's leaves up first (none: returns 0, locks nothing), then after its deletes takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on the tables around the leaves, the two roots (ONLY) and the tenant's own partitions and leaves, in one attempt bounded at 500 ms per lock (below deadlock_timeout) and repeated up to five times with a 0.2 s x attempt backoff, then lock_not_available (55P03) naming the tenant; the detach loop runs under the same 500 ms. The locks are held to the caller's COMMIT; a NOTICE reports the attempt and the hold to function return. SECURITY INVOKER, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC (kept by CREATE OR REPLACE), no grant. DATA EFFECT: none. A function redefinition only; no row is changed by this changeset.
